name: Can AKN Design Group coordinate insurance restoration for luxury renovations or additions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AKN Design Group specializes in coordinating insurance restoration for substantial, customized renovations, including luxury kitchens, spa-inspired bathrooms, whole-home remodels, and even home additions if the scope of damage warrants. We integrate the restoration work with your desired aesthetic and functional upgrades. Our design-build expertise ensures that any reconstruction or enhancement goes beyond mere repair, providing an opportunity to create a truly customized space that enhances your home's long-term value and meets your unique lifestyle needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group can coordinate insurance restoration for luxury renovations and additions, integrating damage repair with customized design upgrades.
